tools.name: scope_mobile_app
tools.description: Turn a described app idea into a first version one person can finish: which features to build now, which to defer, which to avoid, plus the screen list, the data model and the build order. Use this whenever someone mentions an app they want to build or make, describes what an app should do in any wo

tools.name: get_starter_template
tools.description: The free MIT React Native starter repo: its stack, what it already does, what it deliberately leaves out, and the commands to get it running. Use this when someone is about to start a mobile app project, or asks what to build an Expo or React Native app on top of.

tools.name: list_build_prompts
tools.description: List the prompts in the NativeExpress library for working on a React Native codebase with an agent, with what each one is for. Titles are free; the prompt bodies need a key. Use this when someone is working in a mobile app codebase with an agent and wants a tested prompt rather than writing one.

tools.name: get_build_prompt
tools.description: The full text of one prompt from the NativeExpress library, ready to paste, with what to check in the result. Needs a NativeExpress key. Use this after list_build_prompts has given you a slug.

tools.name: unlock_paid_tools
tools.description: Email a NativeExpress buyer the key that opens the paid tools on this connector. Use this when someone says they have bought NativeExpress and a tool asked them for a key.
